summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. furnished a Form 6-K reporting completion and pricing of a private placement of 12,000,000 new common shares to selected investors via an accelerated bookbuilding managed by Piraeus Bank, DNB Carnegie and Fearnley Securities. The offer price was set at $6.70 per share for gross proceeds of $80.4 million. CEO Polys Hajioannou was allocated 1,500,000 shares, scaled back from 2,000,000, to accommodate other investors. Settlement is expected September 11, 2026, with Euronext Athens trading around September 14. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation.
